llm.summary: DINO, on the watch list, had a clean liftoff and strong positive excess return. A successful pick with no fault.
llm.root_cause: DINO, on the watch list, had a clean liftoff and strong positive excess return. A successful pick with no fault.
llm.lesson: Watch-list names in Energy can produce clean liftoffs with the right timing signals.
llm.engines_credit: The rotation model and the watch-list signal engine both made correct calls.
alternate_explanations: A temporary Energy sector rally may have contributed to DINO's performance.

signal_hypotheses.feature: Correlation between sector move and stock excess return for clean liftoffs
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Compute correlation across sector and stock 5-day returns post-liftoff
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Higher correlation suggests sector beta rather than alpha
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: If correlation is low (<0.2), company-specific timing is the main driver.
